name: MoYu Cube Mosaic Art Gallery 10x10 (3.0cm)
description: The MoYu Cube Mosaic Art Gallery 10x10 is a set of 100 30mm 3x3s that come with a display stand that you can use to show off your fabulous mosaics! It comes with a tool to remove the puzzles as well as a pamphlet that gives you ideas on what to create!
